name: viral-content-pipeline
description: End-to-end viral short-form video pipeline: trend discovery -> research -> script -> visuals -> voice -> captions -> render.

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/cli.js run
scripts.render:preview: cd remotion && npx remotion preview src/Root.tsx
scripts.render:video: cd remotion && npx remotion render src/Root.tsx ShortVideo ../output/final-short.mp4
